# VeilCall

VeilCall is a browser calling workspace being developed by VeilCode Studio.
Website purpose: Explain the product and the planned US outbound calling workflow.
Current implementation: Public landing page, with a clearly marked interface preview and an unconnected console placeholder.
Planned Phase 2: Authenticated browser-based outbound calls through Twilio Programmable Voice with a configured authorized US business caller ID.
Planned later: Call activity, notes, contacts, reporting.

Important: The existing website DOES NOT place phone calls and should not be described as a functioning calling service until Phase 2 is implemented and verified.
Website home: /
Private console placeholder: /console
Company: https://veilcode.studio
